title: Can LLMs Ground when they (Don’t) Know: A Study on Direct and Loaded Political Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the models' grounding behavior, knowledge accuracy, and rejection rates of false presuppositions across statements associated with different German political parties across the left-right spectrum (DIE LINKE, SPD, CDU/CSU, AfD).

Comparing the number of correct answers to confirmatory versus disconfirmatory direct questions, and measuring the models' tendency to accommodate false presuppositions rather than explicitly rejecting them to avoid disagreement.
